The '''duel on the ''Chancellor Fillorean''''' took place in [[3963 BBY]], between [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith acolyte/Legends|warrior]] [[Toki Tollivar]]. It took place on board the [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury yacht]] ''[[Chancellor Fillorean]]''. Though the duel was won by Tollivar, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] immediately afterwards by the former [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorian Crusader]] [[Rohlan Dyre]].
